primary_source.exact_scope: Zero-field ferromagnetic nearest-neighbor Ising on Z^3. The source defines g(beta)=sum U4(0,x2,x3,x4)/(chi(beta)^2 xi(beta)^3), with infinite-volume free-state susceptibility and exponential correlation length. Triviality means g(beta) tends to zero as beta increases to beta_c from below. This packet uses the positive sign convention g_+=-g.
